name: Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie on the bench with eyes under the bar
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder width
Unrack the bar and lower it to your chest
Press the bar up until arms are extended
Keep your feet flat on the floor throughout

name: Dumbbell Chest Press
instructions: Lie on a flat bench holding dumbbells at chest level
Press the dumbbells up until arms are extended
Lower slowly to chest level
Keep your wrists straight and core engaged

name: Incline Dumbbell Press
instructions: Set bench to 30-45 degree incline
Hold dumbbells at upper chest level
Press up until arms are extended
Lower with control to the upper chest

name: Chest Fly
instructions: Lie on a flat bench with dumbbells above chest
With slight bend in elbows, lower arms out to sides
Bring dumbbells back together over chest
Focus on the stretch and contraction

name: Cable Chest Fly
instructions: Set cables at chest height
Stand in the middle, grabbing both handles
Bring hands together in front of chest
Control the weight on the return

name: Lat Pulldown
instructions: Sit at the machine with thighs secured
Grab the bar wider than shoulder width
Pull the bar down to your upper chest
Squeeze your back muscles at the bottom
Return slowly to the starting position

name: Seated Cable Row
instructions: Sit at the cable row station
Grab the handle and sit upright
Pull the handle toward your abdomen
Squeeze your back at the peak
Extend arms slowly back

name: Pull-Up
instructions: Hang from a bar with overhand grip
Pull your body up until chin is over the bar
Lower yourself with control
Avoid swinging — keep body straight

name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
instructions: Place one knee and hand on a bench
Hold dumbbell in the opposite hand
Pull the dumbbell toward your hip
Squeeze your back at the top
Lower with full control

name: Deadlift
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart
Grip the bar just outside your legs
Keep back flat and chest up
Drive through your legs to lift
Lock out hips at the top

name: Overhead Press
instructions: Stand with barbell at shoulder height
Press the bar overhead until arms are extended
Keep core tight and avoid arching back
Lower the bar back to shoulders with control

name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
instructions: Sit on a bench with back support
Hold dumbbells at shoulder height
Press dumbbells overhead until arms extend
Lower slowly back to shoulders

name: Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand with dumbbells at your sides
Raise arms out to the sides until shoulder height
Keep a slight bend in your elbows
Lower slowly back to sides

name: Face Pull
instructions: Set cable at head height with rope attachment
Pull the rope toward your face
Spread your hands apart at the end
Squeeze rear delts and upper back
Return with control

name: Bicep Curl
instructions: Stand with dumbbells at your sides
Curl the weights up toward your shoulders
Keep elbows stationary and wrists straight
Squeeze at the top
Lower slowly back to start

name: Hammer Curl
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells with palms facing each other
Curl the weights up keeping neutral grip
Squeeze at the top
Lower slowly with control

name: Tricep Pushdown
instructions: Attach a straight bar to a high pulley
Grip the bar with overhand grip
Push the bar down until arms are extended
Keep elbows close to your body
Return with control

name: Skull Crusher
instructions: Lie on a bench holding a barbell above your face
Lower the bar toward your forehead by bending elbows
Extend arms back to starting position
Keep upper arms stationary

name: Barbell Squat
instructions: Position the bar on your upper back
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart
Descend by bending hips and knees
Keep chest up and back flat
Drive through your feet to stand back up

name: Leg Press
instructions: Sit in the leg press machine
Place feet shoulder-width on the platform
Lower the weight by bending your knees
Press back up without locking your knees
Keep your lower back flat on the seat

name: Walking Lunges
instructions: Hold dumbbells at your sides
Step forward and lower your back knee toward the ground
Keep your front knee aligned with your ankle
Push through your front foot to step forward
Alternate legs with each step

name: Lying Leg Curl
instructions: Lie face down on the leg curl machine
Place your heels under the pads
Curl your legs up toward your glutes
Squeeze at the top
Lower slowly back down

name: Leg Extension
instructions: Sit in the leg extension machine
Place your ankles under the pads
Extend your legs until straight
Squeeze your quads at the top
Lower slowly back to start

name: Plank
instructions: Get into a push-up position on forearms
Keep your body in a straight line
Engage your core and glutes
Hold the position
Breathe steadily throughout

name: Crunch
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent
Place hands behind your head
Lift your shoulders off the ground
Squeeze your abs at the top
Lower slowly back down

name: Russian Twist
instructions: Sit on the floor with knees bent
Lean back slightly to engage core
Twist your torso to one side
Return to center and twist to the other side
Keep your back straight throughout

name: Leg Raise
instructions: Lie on your back with legs straight
Place hands under your hips for support
Raise your legs until they're perpendicular to the floor
Lower slowly without touching the ground
Keep your lower back pressed down

name: Treadmill Walking
instructions: Set an appropriate incline and speed
Walk with good posture
Use the handrails only for balance
Stay hydrated

name: Treadmill Running
instructions: Warm up with a light walk
Set your desired running speed
Maintain proper running form
Cool down with a walk at the end

name: Stationary Bike
instructions: Adjust the seat height properly
Start with a moderate resistance
Maintain a steady pace
Cool down gradually

name: Elliptical Trainer
instructions: Step onto the pedals and grab the handles
Set your desired resistance and incline
Move smoothly through the full stride
Keep an upright posture

name: Burpees
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart
Squat down and place hands on the floor
Jump your feet back into a plank
Perform a push-up (optional)
Jump feet back to your hands and jump up

name: Kettlebell Swing
instructions: Stand with feet wider than shoulder width
Hold the kettlebell with both hands
Hinge at the hips and swing the kettlebell back
Drive your hips forward to swing it up
Let gravity bring it back between your legs
